title: Pakistan Extends Airspace Ban on Indian Flights
excerpt: Pakistan has prolonged the airspace closure for Indian aircraft until November 24, extending the restriction for another month.
body_html:
Pakistan has officially prolonged the closure of its airspace for all Indian aircraft. The restriction has been extended by an additional month and will now remain in effect until November 24.

With this extension, Indian flights will continue to be barred from utilizing Pakistani airspace, maintaining the ongoing aviation measures between the two neighboring countries.
